cleaned.title: Mass shooting in South Africa kills 11

sentences.text: At least 11 people were killed and three others injured in a mass shooting at a house party in the KwaMakhutha township, south of Durban, police reported.
Among the dead was a pregnant woman, and two people survived the attack, according to provincial officials.
Three assailants opened fire on the partygoers, herding everyone into a single room before setting fire to a vehicle belonging to one of the victims, local reports stated.
Police have launched a manhunt for the suspects and have not ruled out a feud between rival groupings as a motive.
The incident occurred in a country with one of the world's highest murder rates, averaging about 60 deaths daily.
